# Denormalization Register

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @xos/schemas generate:denormalization` from docs/adr/denormalization-register.yaml. Never edit by hand. -->

Section 3.15 allows a materialized view or stored derived value only for measured performance. Each one is listed here. The register's source is [`denormalization-register.yaml`](denormalization-register.yaml); this page is generated from it, and so is `supabase/tests/1282_denormalization_register.psql`, the allow-lists the pgTAP catalog lints in `supabase/tests/1282_normalization_lints.test.sql` and the tenant column check in `supabase/tests/0202_identity_core.test.sql` read. A new json or jsonb column, array column, restated parent column, stored total or `app` table without the tenant columns fails those tests until it is reviewed and listed below (ADR 0068).

## JSON columns

ADR 0002 allows JSON columns only for rich text documents, audit diffs and provider payloads. `registered` means the column is a derived entry above; `finding` means it is a violation with an open finding.

| Column                                          | Exception        | Why                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `app.ai_suggestion_fields.proposed_value`       | provider-payload | A field value the AI model proposed, kept as it answered until a person accepts or edits it.              |
| `app.audit_events.diff`                         | audit-diff       | The audit ledger's diff of each write.                                                                    |
| `app.automation_run_steps.request_body`         | provider-payload | Body sent to the operation (migration 1481).                                                              |
| `app.automation_run_steps.response_body`        | provider-payload | The operation's answer, trimmed to its identifying fields (migration 1481).                               |
| `app.automation_runs.event_payload`             | provider-payload | The event as webhooks send it, the run's input (migration 1481).                                          |
| `app.domain_events.data`                        | provider-payload | Outbound webhook payload.                                                                                 |
| `app.form_submissions.answers`                  | registered       | Answers to one immutable form version (A22-008).                                                          |
| `app.form_template_versions.fields`             | registered       | Published form definition (A22-008).                                                                      |
| `app.form_templates.fields`                     | registered       | Draft form definition (A22-008).                                                                          |
| `app.idempotency_keys.response_body`            | provider-payload | The API response returned verbatim on replay.                                                             |
| `app.import_row_results.before_image`           | audit-diff       | The target's changed columns before an import wrote them, used to undo it.                                |
| `app.integration_connections.provider_settings` | provider-payload | Provider configuration the connector validates, such as calendar ids and default accounts. Never secrets. |
| `app.integration_inbound_events.payload`        | provider-payload | The part of the provider's payload the worker needs, at most 64 KB (migration 1400).                      |
| `app.notifications.message_args`                | provider-payload | Display arguments the catalog messages render for every channel; never relational.                        |
| `app.org_domains.dns_records`                   | provider-payload | DNS records as the email or hosting provider gave them (migration 1355).                                  |
| `app.platform_operator_actions.details`         | audit-diff       | What an operator action changed, as display values (migration 1470).                                      |
| `app.stripe_events.payload`                     | provider-payload | Stripe event as sent, after signature verification.                                                       |
| `app.sync_mutations.result`                     | provider-payload | The result returned to every replay of a Compass mutation.                                                |
| `app.time_entry_audit.new_values`               | audit-diff       | Clock times after a change.                                                                               |
| `app.time_entry_audit.old_values`               | audit-diff       | Clock times before a change.                                                                              |
| `private.account_deletions.result`              | audit-diff       | What an account deletion erased and kept, as returned to the person (migration 1112).                     |
| `private.account_security_events.detail`        | audit-diff       | Facts of a security event in the person's own log (migration 1560).                                       |
| `private.platform_emails.args`                  | provider-payload | Template arguments for the email provider, cleared once sent (migration 1382).                            |

| `app.person_work_details.accessibility_needs` | reviewed | A set of fixed enum values a person picks, never joined on; a free-text note carries the rest (migration 1340).      |

| `app.survey_questions.choices`                | reviewed | The ordered answer texts of one question (A22-008).                                                                  |
| `app.training_quiz_questions.options`         | reviewed | The ordered answer texts of one question; the quiz key follows its option (A22-008, migration 1042).                 |
| `app.work_detail_events.categories`           | reviewed | The set of work detail categories an access touched, in the person's append-only log (migration 1340).               |
| `app.work_detail_events.changed_columns`      | reviewed | Column names an edit changed, in the person's append-only log; a log payload, never a relationship (migration 1340). |
| `app.work_detail_events.fact_kinds`           | reviewed | The set of project fact kinds an access touched, in the person's append-only log (R5, migration 2654).               |
| `app.work_detail_shares.categories`           | reviewed | The set of work detail categories a share grants, read whole (migration 1340).                                       |

## Restated parent columns

A column with the same name and type as a column of the table one of its foreign keys references, outside that table's primary key, restates that column unless a composite foreign key keeps the two equal. `registered` is a derived entry above; `fact` is kept as it was when written while the parent can change later; `own` is the row's own value, which can differ from the parent's or which the row needs without the link, because the link is optional.

| `app.access_grid.project_id`                           | `app.credential_categories.project_id`                   | registered | Copied from the category by `private.copy_parent_project` (derived entry).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `app.access_scans.project_id`                          | `app.credentials.project_id`                             | registered | Copied from the credential by `private.copy_parent_project` (derived entry).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

### Names the restated-column lint never compares

These names describe the row itself wherever they appear. The lint never compares them and never follows a foreign key made only of them, so `org_id` and the ADR 0002 row stamps never pull in the organization or the person who wrote a row.

| Name                | Why                                                                                               |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `body`              | The row's own text.                                                                               |
| `created_at`        | ADR 0002 row stamp.                                                                               |
| `created_by`        | ADR 0002 row stamp.                                                                               |
| `deleted_at`        | ADR 0002 row stamp.                                                                               |
| `description`       | The row's own text.                                                                               |
| `id`                | The row's own key.                                                                                |
| `label`             | The row's own text.                                                                               |
| `name`              | The row's own name. A child named under a project, venue or org shares only the column name.      |
| `note`              | The row's own text.                                                                               |
| `notes`             | The row's own text.                                                                               |
| `ordinal`           | The row's place among its siblings.                                                               |
| `org_id`            | ADR 0002 tenant key, derived by trigger on every tenant table and never accepted from the caller. |
| `position`          | The row's place among its siblings.                                                               |
| `sort_order`        | The row's place among its siblings.                                                               |
| `source_created_at` | Canon provenance stamp of the source workbook row (xpms).                                         |
| `source_created_by` | Canon provenance stamp of the source workbook row (xpms).                                         |
| `source_row`        | Canon provenance stamp of the source workbook row (xpms).                                         |
| `source_status`     | Canon provenance stamp of the source workbook row (xpms).                                         |
| `source_updated_at` | Canon provenance stamp of the source workbook row (xpms).                                         |
| `title`             | The row's own text.                                                                               |
| `updated_at`        | ADR 0002 row stamp.                                                                               |
| `updated_by`        | ADR 0002 row stamp.                                                                               |

## Stored values named like totals

Columns named like a total, count, sum, balance, score, percent or readiness that are not generated columns. `fact` is fixed when something happened and later rows cannot reproduce it; `input` is set by a person, a provider or the canon.

| Column                                           | Kind       | Why                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `app.addon_purchases.amount_total_minor`         | input      | Amount paid as Stripe reports it (migration 1250).                                                                         |
| `app.beos.guest_count`                           | input      | Guests the client guarantees.                                                                                              |
| `app.export_jobs.row_count`                      | fact       | Rows a run exported; not derivable later (A22 review).                                                                     |
| `app.form_submissions.max_score`                 | registered | Fixed by the immutable form version at submission.                                                                         |
| `app.form_submissions.score`                     | registered | Fixed by the immutable form version and answers at submission.                                                             |
| `app.form_template_versions.pass_score`          | input      | Passing score the author set, frozen in the version.                                                                       |
| `app.form_templates.pass_score`                  | input      | Passing score the author sets.                                                                                             |
| `app.import_job_sheets.column_count`             | fact       | Counted from the uploaded workbook at detection; its cells are not stored (migration 1402).                                |
| `app.import_job_sheets.data_row_count`           | fact       | Counted from the uploaded workbook at detection; its cells are not stored (migration 1402).                                |
| `app.invite_links.use_count`                     | fact       | Memberships do not record the link they came from (A22 review).                                                            |
| `app.notification_deliveries.attempt_count`      | fact       | No attempts table exists, so the count is the only record (A22 review).                                                    |
| `app.occupancy_counters.alert_level_percent`     | registered | Set with the count under the counter's lock, so each alert level fires once.                                               |
| `app.occupancy_counters.current_count`           | registered | Kept by the door counts (A22-007).                                                                                         |
| `app.occupancy_counts.count_after`               | registered | Running count at each entry (A22-007).                                                                                     |
| `app.org_exports.file_count`                     | fact       | Counted when the archive was built; the archive is a file (migration 1063).                                                |
| `app.org_exports.row_count`                      | fact       | Counted when the archive was built; the archive is a file (migration 1063).                                                |
| `app.org_exports.table_count`                    | fact       | Counted when the archive was built; the archive is a file (migration 1063).                                                |
| `app.osha_annual_summaries.total_hours_worked`   | input      | The establishment's Form 300A figure; `app.osha_employment_estimate` only suggests one from time entries (migration 1385). |
| `app.ratings.score`                              | input      | A rating of 1 to 5.                                                                                                        |
| `app.report_runs.row_count`                      | fact       | Rows a run returned; not derivable later (A22 review).                                                                     |
| `app.report_runs.unpriced_count`                 | fact       | Unpriced rows of a run; not derivable later (A22 review).                                                                  |
| `app.share_links.open_count`                     | fact       | Opens are logged by file, not by link, so the count is the only per-link record (migration 1380).                          |
| `app.shipments.pallet_count`                     | input      | Pallets shipped (migration 1180).                                                                                          |
| `app.shipments.piece_count`                      | input      | Pieces shipped (migration 1180).                                                                                           |
| `app.tax_rates.rate_percent`                     | input      | A tax rate.                                                                                                                |
| `app.training_completions.score_percent`         | fact       | Quiz answers are graded and not kept, so the score is the only record.                                                     |
| `app.training_courses.pass_percent`              | input      | Passing score the author sets.                                                                                             |
| `app.vendor_scorecards.delivery_score`           | input      | A rating of 1 to 5.                                                                                                        |
| `app.vendor_scorecards.quality_score`            | input      | A rating of 1 to 5.                                                                                                        |
| `app.vendor_scorecards.safety_score`             | input      | A rating of 1 to 5.                                                                                                        |
| `app.warehouse_delivery_files.byte_count`        | fact       | Size of the file delivered to the warehouse (migration 1401).                                                              |
| `app.warehouse_delivery_files.row_count`         | fact       | Rows in the file delivered to the warehouse (migration 1401).                                                              |
| `app.webhook_deliveries.attempt_count`           | fact       | No attempts table exists, so the count is the only record (A22 review).                                                    |
| `app.wholesale_statements.client_count`          | finding    | Count of the statement's lines (migration 1060). ([A108-002](../../legal/qa/findings/A108-002.md))                         |
| `app.wholesale_statements.list_total_minor`      | finding    | Sum of the statement's priced lines (migration 1060). ([A108-002](../../legal/qa/findings/A108-002.md))                    |
| `app.wholesale_statements.unpriced_count`        | finding    | Count of the statement's unpriced lines (migration 1060). ([A108-002](../../legal/qa/findings/A108-002.md))                |
| `app.wholesale_statements.wholesale_total_minor` | finding    | Sum of the statement's priced lines (migration 1060). ([A108-002](../../legal/qa/findings/A108-002.md))                    |
| `private.api_rate_windows.request_count`         | fact       | Requests are not logged, so the count is the only record of the window (migration 1040).                                   |
| `private.subprocessor_notices.recipient_count`   | fact       | Queued emails do not name the notice, so the count is the only record (migration 1382).                                    |
| `xpms.dim_gl_account_type.normal_balance`        | input      | Debit or Credit, a canon value, not a balance.                                                                             |
| `xpms.dim_grain.counts`                          | input      | Canon text saying what the grain counts.                                                                                   |
| `xpms.playbook_sheet.data_row_count`             | fact       | Rows in the source workbook sheet, recorded at import.                                                                     |

## Tables without the tenant columns

ADR 0002 puts `org_id` and the audit columns on every tenant table. The identity rows of Section 4.8.1 and platform tables belong to no org, and ADR 0019 item 10 keeps person-owned rows outside an org, which ADR 0033 decision 69 accepts as a stated exception.

| Table                                     | Kind         | Why                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `app.active_org_selections`               | person-owned | One row per sign-in, keyed by user_id (ADR 0007 item 1, migration 0920).                                                  |
| `app.airports`                            | platform     | Airports by IATA code, seeded by migration from packages/schemas/airports/airports.csv (R5, migration 2651).              |
| `app.blocks`                              | person-owned | Blocks keyed by person_id, readable only by the blocker (A52, migration 1206).                                            |
| `app.capabilities`                        | platform     | Capability registry rows generated from capabilities.yaml.                                                                |
| `app.capability_modules`                  | platform     | Capability modules generated from capabilities.yaml.                                                                      |
| `app.deletion_certificates`               | platform     | The record of an org's deletion, kept after the org and its members are gone (A79, migration 1351).                       |
| `app.feedback_submissions`                | person-owned | Feedback a person sends the platform team, keyed by person_id, read by the sender and staff (A96, migration 1531).        |
| `app.organizations`                       | identity     | The tenant itself (Section 4.8.1).                                                                                        |
| `app.people`                              | identity     | One human across orgs (Section 4.8.1).                                                                                    |
| `app.person_calendar_feeds`               | person-owned | A person's own calendar feed across their engagements, keyed by person_id (A84, migration 1410).                          |
